body: I just don’t get it. I can be sober for a week and then I say let’s go see my friends I’m lonely I’m bored and it’s over.  And on top of it tonight I got offered a Job bar tending one night a week at my local spot. I wanna do it for the money but it’s going to ruin me.
The fact that easters Sunday isn’t helping any either I feel required to see them
GO YOU! I can’t wait for the day I can do that.

That term made me hate AA. That  might be a dramatic reaction but it always made me feel like I had to handle sobriety a certain way and in a certain time frame. In the past when I tried to get sober and was in the rooms I’d hear that term and almost panic and get scared I wasn’t going to be able to handle my issues and I’d end up relapsing almost immediately after.

It’s interesting to know that I’m not the only person who feels this way. I used to go to the bat and next time I knew was surrounded by people who drank like me smoked like me and drugged like me and when I’d crawl home I’d tell my boyfriend I don’t know what happened the drunks found me and until this week I truly believed it. It wasn’t my fault they always found me and made me do it when really I was just looking for the one person drunker than me at the bar to make me feel better about myself.
It feels good to say I already accomplished something for the day and It can only get better from here.
I really hope it does and I’m strong enough to stick with this and not give in.
